description: Fetch UNESCO UIS statistic values: education, literacy, school enrollment/completion, science (R&D) and culture indicators. Returns {records:[{indicatorId,geoUnit,year,value}]}. Indicator IDs come from list_indicators; geoUnit is an ISO3 country code (e.g. "BRA") from list_geounits. Both accept one or many (comma-separated) values; empty records means no data for that indicator/country/year combination.

geoUnit.description: ISO3 country/region code(s) from list_geounits, e.g. "BRA". Multiple comma-separated: "BRA,ARG".

indicator.description: Indicator ID(s) from list_indicators, e.g. "CR.1" or "10". Multiple comma-separated: "CR.1,CR.2".

name: get_data
